brief: Individually modeled Dubai residential tower with inset bowed balconies, cream window piers, checkerboard upper glazing, raised keyhole-and-pediment crowns, two pointed ornamental rings and a striped dome with flared spire.

reconstruction.shaft: Individual inset bowed slabs/guards and glass panes retain the original floor rhythm; continuous cream piers/spandrels and flat framing replace tiny joint beams and repeated cell shells.
reconstruction.crown: Two glazed/slit tiers retain pointed petal rings and closed striped dome/flared spire with bounded finite sampling; temporary construction gaps and raised tiny seam tubes are excluded.
reconstruction.base: Six reconstructed podium courses, parking louvers and approximate southwest arrival frontage. Picture/PMTiles placement accepted for world-viewer use; exact doorway compass bearing is not claimed.
